content.text:
I've submitted index 18 (Mn 0.51, Y 0.49), which gave the highest photocurrent of the three I measured: 1.6e-7 A. The episode is finished and the merit budget is used up.

| Index | Mn fraction | Photocurrent (A) |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 0.41 | 8e-8 |
| 18 | 0.51 | 1.6e-7 |
| 15 | 0.67 | 2e-8 |

- **Why index 18:** it sits at the YMnO₃ composition. The models put YMnO₃ on the stability hull with a predicted band gap of about 1.3 eV, so the 3.22 eV light is strongly absorbed.
- **Trend:** photocurrent drops on both sides of the 1:1 composition. So the best spot is probably near index 18, but with only three points it may lie between the ones I measured.
- **Left out:** the Y-rich end (Mn below 0.3) is mostly Y₂O₃. Its predicted gap is about 5.6 eV, so it shouldn't absorb at 3.22 eV, and the measured trend was already falling that way.

I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase assignments above come from the models, not from diffraction on the films.
